issues.detail: Rule fixes 12-hour wrap/PM-toggle point; spec only says 12-hour clock with am/pm, so hour rollover point is not explicit.
issues.spec_evidence: Create a set of counters suitable for use as a 12-hour clock (with am/pm indicator).
issues.alternative: Hour wraps 12->01 immediately on the first increment after reset 12:00:00, instead of after 12:59:59.

issues.detail: R_NORMAL example first vector has reset=1 while R_NORMAL condition requires reset==0; expected outputs rely on R_RESET.
issues.spec_evidence: Reset has higher priority than enable and can occur even when not enabled.
